name: DaSiWa Krea 2: DarkDesire v3 Turbo (int8)
author: Darksidewalker
note: His Krea 2 turbo line, in int8 (ConvRot; the fp8_mixed file of the same size is his primary): 8 steps at CFG 1 with euler and linear_quadratic (er_sde/simple works too), made for 1536 x 1536, set here. Both realism and anime, with anime composition pushed in each version. Krea 2's own text encoder and VAE are the official ones. The Raw line of the same page is the undistilled one: CFG 3.5, 52 steps or more. Rechecked against his page on 5 October 2026: DarkDesire v3 is his newest.
